entry.summary:
SH2 Meeanee Road Roundabout – Upcoming works and Traffic Impacts:
We will soon begin enabling works for the construction of the new Meeanee Rd overbridge. There will be temporary traffic movements at SH2 / Meeanee Rd Roundabout.
